sources.title: 29 CFR 1910.22 General requirements
sources.scope: Walking-working surfaces must be kept clean, orderly, sanitary, and free of hazards such as sharp or protruding objects, loose boards, corrosion, leaks, spills, snow, and ice.

sources.title: 29 CFR 1910.334 Use of equipment
sources.scope: Damaged cord-and-plug equipment must be removed from service; equipment used where water contact is likely must be approved for that location.

sources.title: 29 CFR 1910.23 Ladders
sources.scope: Ladders must be inspected, used only on stable and level surfaces unless secured/stabilized, and used according to their design.
